question: Which multi-lane edge has the most unequal lane usage, measured by the lowest Shannon entropy of vehicle distribution across lanes? For each multi-lane edge, compute the total vehicle observations on each lane across all FCD timesteps. Then compute the Shannon entropy (base-2) of the resulting distribution: H = -sum(p_i * log2(p_i)) where p_i = lane_count / total_count (skip lanes with 0 count). Lower entropy means more unequal. Break ties by higher total vehicle count, then lexicographic edge ID. Answer format: <edge_id>
